name: Shadowsong Shrine
summary: In western Azshara, Shadowsong Shrine lies in haunted ruin near the Ashenvale border. Ancient Highborne spirits haunt the hillside sanctuary. Its name recalls Maiev Shadowsong, though its tie to her bloodline remains a mystery.

sections.title: A Haunted Legacy
sections.body:
Shadowsong Shrine crowns a hill above Azshara’s shattered lands, its stones lost beneath overgrowth. Highborne ghosts wander the ruins and try to kill mortals who enter their domain.

The shrine bears the name of Maiev Shadowsong, the warden of Illidan Stormrage. Time has erased whether it honors her family or predates the Sundering.

faq.answer: Shadowsong Shrine lies in crumbled ruin on a hill in western Azshara. Hostile Highborne spirits haunt the old night elf sanctuary.

faq.q: Who is the shrine named after?
faq.answer: Shadowsong Shrine shares its name with Maiev Shadowsong, the warden who held Illidan Stormrage captive. Whether the shrine honors Maiev or her family is unknown.
The Great Sundering devastated Shadowsong Shrine ten thousand years ago. Highborne spirits slain in the cataclysm remain bound to the stones, mad and hostile toward the living.
Shadowsong Shrine sits on a hill in western Azshara, east of the Ashenvale border and near Talrendis Point.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the respect Maiev Shadowsong commands. Tormented Highborne ghosts haunt the shrine that bears her name.
